_readme: Spec 67. Atlas's avatar mode: a video-call-style stage in the Atlas panel (assets/js/agent-avatar.js, lazy-loaded by agent-widget.js). Avatar 'Sam' + voice 'Puck', picked by hand in Console -> Agent Platform -> Studio -> Stream realtime (model gemini-3.8-live, Live Avatar panel). 'idle' is a muted ping-pong loop cut from a live idle session so the face never looks frozen; the greeting plays once when Avatar is picked. Live answers are generated per turn, not stored here.

chapters.script: Hi, I'm Atlas, Gaurav's AI agent. I can tell you who he is, how this site got built, or just answer whatever you're curious about. Tap a topic, or ask me anything.
